jobs.name: p1_A
jobs.prompt: An ink and watercolor wash illustration on toned paper. Loose, confident black ink brush lines with dry-brush texture; layered transparent washes of deep indigo, umber and slate gray; the paper grain shows through the washes; highlights left as bare paper; large simple shapes, deep shadows, detail only where the light falls. Night on a steep hillside, long ago. A column of legionaries in rust-red cloaks and dull bronze helmets carries torches down a path into a great deep cut in the hill, small figures in a long line descending from the upper left; one carries a standard marked VII. Far below at the bottom of the cut, one enormous pale ribbed curve breaks out of the dark earth, like the back of a sleeping whale breaking the sea, bigger than the cut itself; only that curve is seen. Torches close in the foreground, torch smoke and falling sparks, the column in the middle distance, the pale curve far below in darkness. The only strong color is the orange-gold torchlight; everything else is night.

jobs.name: p4_A
jobs.prompt: An ink and watercolor wash illustration on toned paper. Loose, confident black ink brush lines with dry-brush texture; layered transparent washes of deep indigo, umber and slate gray; the paper grain shows through the washes; highlights left as bare paper; large simple shapes, deep shadows, detail only where the light falls. Night, hard frost on a field beside a road. Small orange embers glint in the dark soil like coals in ash. A dead man stands slack and blank-faced, his skin gray, a warm orange light glowing from inside his open mouth, his eye sockets and his wounds, like a lamp behind paper. An old watchman with a gray beard, in a slate blue-gray cloak, with a round wooden shield on his arm, drives a spear into the dead man's chest; the light pours out of the wound onto the frost as a scatter of small glowing stones. The watchman's breath smokes in the cold air. The orange-gold light is the only strong color; the rest is cold night and frost.

Loose, confident black ink brush lines with dry-brush texture; layered transparent washes of deep indigo, umber and slate gray; the paper grain shows through the washes; highlights left as bare paper; large simple shapes, deep shadows, detail only where the light falls. Dusk, the last light: a deep blue sky over a dull rose band low on the horizon. A small camp beside a dirt road: a campfire burning high, a log, a bedroll unrolled with its blanket still folded on it, a pack. A lone traveler sits by the fire with the hood of a long coat up, seen from behind, reading a folded letter, a small flask on a cord wound round one wrist. Far up the road, the tiny warm lamps of a distant waystation, one lamp higher than the rest. Low through the dark trees to the right, by unseen water, three small points of cold pale-blue light. The firelight is warm orange-gold; the dark around it is blue.
